title: Modern oasis: near everything but away from it all
description:
Welcome to Mondrian Cottage, your one-of-a-kind modern oasis inspired by the art of Piet Mondrian! Private luxury hideaway in prime East Nashville, full of art and surrounded by lush gardens.  Light-filled, two-story, newly custom-built:  full kitchen & bath, washer/dryer, skylights. Steps from local shops, bars, restaurants &  music venues, on a quiet, historic residential street.  Pleasant stroll to Nissan Stadium; quick ride to downtown & all attractions. Near everything & away from it all.

The space
Your art-filled, clean, modern, two-story, 600 sq ft cottage is tucked away in the backyard of a beautifully restored Victorian, surrounded by lush gardens. You will feel away from it all even though you are near everything. 

You can easily ditch your car and walk or rideshare everywhere you might want to go! There's so much to do right here in the neighborhood. You can wind your way on foot to Nissan Stadium in 30 minutes, admiring the houses and shops and bars on the way. You can hop a rideshare and be in the heart of downtown honky-tonks, museums, the Ryman, the Symphony, and Bridgestone Arena in 10 minutes.  Check out the Guidebook (in the Arrival guide)! 

The cottage itself is one of a kind. Built in 2020-21 from a custom design, it finds inspiration in the clean geometric lines and primary colors of Mondrian's art. Full of unique and luxury touches, like custom art, iconic Hatch Show Print concert prints, and top-drawer bed linens.

Entering on the ground floor you will find a tranquil, well-laid-out open plan space with a full kitchen (Keurig coffeemaker, stainless steel appliances), dining area, and living room (with leather sofa, bluetooth speaker, and smart TV). The sofa easily can sleep a child; we can also provide you with an air mattress for a second child.  The first floor also has a utility room with a full-sized washer and dryer, as well as a roll-out butcher block unit for extra counter space, iron & board, and stepstool.

Up the stairs you will find a wide hallway with a bench and space for luggage, a full bathroom with glass block and a tiled tub/shower combination,  and the master bedroom. The bedroom is a true aerie: clean lines, calming colors, skylights, and a queen bed with a high-end Tuft & Needle mattress and top-drawer linens. Plenty of drawers and hangers for all your things. The master bedroom has four beautiful skylights. Flexible, removable blackout shades that attach with magnets are there for you if you like a very dark room at night.  (If you are short like me, and could use a stepstool to reach the top of the skylights, there's one downstairs in the utility room.)

We are a residential street, so this is definitely not a party house - though feel free to enjoy the Nashville party scene and come home here to recover! Just outside the cottage door you will find a shady area overlooking the garden, with chairs for you to hang out and have your coffee in. You may get an affectionate greeting from some adorable mini-Schnoodles and a curious hello from a sweet cat.  Ample street parking, and covered carport parking by request and an additional fee.

I am an Airbnb Superhost. You can see from the reviews that everyone loves this little cottage. Seriously, it's pretty great.

(Please note that, according to local regulations, the principal guest--meaning the person who books the cottage--must be at least 21 years old.)

Guest access
The entire Mondrian Cottage is yours. A sweet sitting area awaits you outdoors, tucked under a maple tree.

A perfect East Nashville weekend does not require getting in the car. Coffee? Brunch? Dinner? Shopping? Cocktails? Walk by the river? All walkable, all good. Check out some ideas in the online Guidebook. Or you can hop a rideshare and be at the honky-tonks in about 10 minutes. There is also a major metro bus route that stops a block and a half away and will drop you at the Music City Central transit hub downtown. 

Ample street parking. Let us know if you'd like to be able to use the carport for an additional fee.

Other things to note
Metro Nashville regulations require that the principal guest -- the person who books the cottage -- must be at least 21 years old. If your entire party is under 21, we are sorry that we cannot host you.
